431055676.body: ps5 mihawkos-v7.1.0-alpha-7 mihawkos is a passion project, not a piracy project it exists so you can play the games you own on the console you own piracy is not condoned no games, saves, keys, firmware or exploits are included, and they never will be use only games and programs you have the right to run : your own copies, bought or installed by you requests for, or links to, games, keys, firmware or exploits are not welcome in this project s issues or discussions mihawkos s own on-screen keyboard. games inside mihawkos no longer freeze waiting for input. updates that say what they re doing an update to the seventh alpha of mihawkos, the homebrew title that runs windows games on a ps5 from a desktop of their own, mihawk os. it is still experimental. from alpha 7, update by replacing the ppsa99170 folder alpha 7 s own update cannot install it ; from 7.1 on, mihawkos updates itself mihawkos s own on-screen keyboard it works on every firmware now. alpha 7 borrowed the ps5 s system keyboard, which cannot be loaded by homebrew on firmware 13.60, so the keyboard never opened there. mihawkos now draws its own at the bottom of the screen, with the game visible above it. open it during a game the way you chose in settings controls a two-finger touchpad click, l3 r3, or options touchpad click frosted meadow look: see-through frosted glass that shows the game blurred behind it, glossy aero keys, soap bubbles rising at its sides, and a soft light that crosses the glass once after it opens, then at most every 30 seconds, never while you are typing instant. a key press shows on screen 2 to 5 ms later measured on a standard ps5, firmware 13.60 while it is open it costs the game about 3 ms per frame; closed, nothing games inside mihawkos no more freezing until the mouse moves. in alpha 7, a game inside mihawkos could stop for seconds at a time, its music still playing, until a mouse or controller input arrived. a wake-up meant for input stayed set when no input came so the game s main loop spun on it and its timers never fired. our own test program shows it: in alpha 7 its first 16 ms wait never returned in 3 minutes; in 7.1 every wait came back on time longest 17 ms . this test is now part of every release s checks clearer crash reports. when a game inside mihawkos fails to read a part of a file it has mapped into memory, the log now says why, so these crashes can be diagnosed from a report updates the update line says what it s doing , in your language: checking, downloading with mb and percent , checking the signature, preparing with percent , ready. if something goes wrong it says why: the update server could not be reached, the download stopped, there is not enough space, or the download did not match mihawkos s signature it is then not used, and mihawkos stays as it is it checks every time you open mihawkos from the home screen , at most once an hour, instead of once a day returning from a game does not check no double check after an update. mihawkos no longer asks again right after restarting into the new version updates that start. alpha 7 s updater wrote the new version without permission to run its programs, so the updated mihawkos could not start. 7.1 s updater sets it, and reads a new signed file that alpha 7 never sees played on the console this release s build was tested on a standard ps5 firmware 13.60 the full test battery of 121 cases on a freshly restarted console: 119 passed and 2 were skipped by a test-network setting v71-fix-gate-base-2026-11-02 7.1 updating itself to a newer test build: it found it, downloaded it 555 mb , checked its signature, switched and the new version started from the switched folder, its programs allowed to run. its own restart and a return from a game did not check again; opening mihawkos did updating from alpha 7 by replacing the folder: on a console set up with alpha 7 and its runtime, the 7.1 folder was copied over the old one. 7.1 topped up its runtime by itself 12 files, 11.7 seconds , every file matched the package its programs were allowed to run, and the prefix and settings were kept the keyboard: its 5 checks pass on the console opening it, moving and typing, changing pages, closing , with 2 to 5 ms from a key press to the screen known limits tested on a standard ps5 firmware 13.60 only. no ps5 pro was run with this build the input-freeze fix is proven with our test program, not yet with a game. testers who saw a game freeze until they moved the mouse: please try again and send logs spelunky 2 stays on a black screen: it asks for memory at addresses the ps5 does not give to programs. under investigation the witcher 3 started from the mihawk os desktop closes itself at once. start it from the library or files only one game at a time runs inside mihawkos. a second game, and 32-bit games, run the old way a game that freezes on its loading screen may not be closed by itself yet: close mihawkos from the ps button menu restart the ps5 now and then. pipe memory runs out after very many program starts; mihawkos says restart the ps5 when that happens the per-boot setup is yours: your payloads after every cold boot. never use rest mode with payloads loaded not supported: drm such as denuvo, and anti-cheat such as easy anti-cheat or battleye everything else from alpha 7 still applies installing or updating ps5 mihawkos-v7.1.0-alpha-7.zip size: 555.4 mb; each component keeps its own licence, listed with its pin in notice.md thank you to the testers who sent their logs and videos , which found the keyboard on firmware 13.60, the freeze that only the mouse could end, and the update line s silent failures; to skeuoss for bubble city , whose bubbles now rise beside the keyboard too; and to the wine , proton , dxvk , vkd3d-proton and mesa developers mihawkos is an independent hobby project, not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by sony interactive entertainment, microsoft, valve, amd, capcom, cd projekt red or any game publisher. playstation, ps5 and dualsense are trademarks of sony interactive entertainment inc.; windows is a trademark of microsoft corporation; steam and proton are trademarks of valve corporation; radeon is a trademark of advanced micro devices, inc. you are responsible for having the right to the programs you run, and for whether modifying your console is lawful where you live legal.md ready to get started? available releases installation guide source and credits ready to get started? available releases installation guide source and credits

432827456.body: ps5 mihawkos-v8.0.0-alpha-8 mihawkos is a passion project, not a piracy project it exists so you can play the games you own on the console you own piracy is not condoned no games, saves, keys, firmware or exploits are included, and they never will be use only games and programs you have the right to run : your own copies, bought or installed by you requests for, or links to, games, keys, firmware or exploits are not welcome in this project s issues or discussions a glass control panel over every game. your controller in more games. steadier frames, and far fewer freezes the eighth alpha of mihawkos, the homebrew title that runs windows games on a ps5 from a desktop of their own mihawk os. it is still experimental. from 7.1, mihawkos offers this update by itself. the first start after updating takes longer, once: every windows setup refreshes its windows files a single time what s new: control overlay : exit, live statistics, keyboard, mouse and controller, over any game what s new: your controller in more games : xbox 360, xbox one or dualsense, switched while you play what s new: steadier frames : games wait for the tv like on a pc, 119.8 fps at 120 hz what s new: typing in real time : the on-screen keyboard types into the game key by key what s new: online games connect again : web requests through windows winhttp work what s new: fewer freezes and crashes for games inside mihawkos, and no black screen in spelunky 2 what s new: visual c already installed : games stop asking what s new: steam warns before it runs out of room on older firmware the control overlay press l3 r3 during a game. a frosted-glass panel opens over it, the game still running behind, with five buttons exit ends the game and brings you back to mihawkos statistics shows a small box in the top-left corner: frame rate, frame time, gpu load, and the console s page tables in both pools, so you can see when a game is near the console s limits. it costs the game about 0.2 ms per frame keyboard opens mihawkos s own on-screen keyboard mouse turns the mouse off and on while you play controller changes which controller the game sees, xbox 360, xbox one or dualsense , while it runs. the panel says what to expect from each one the panel keeps a 120 hz game smooth while it is open: 119.8 to 119.9 frames per second, measured on the console your controller in more games games that never saw the controller now do. until 7.1, only games that use xinput found your controller. games that read it through directinput, raw input, winmm or sdl, and the engines built on them, now find it too ys origin , which never saw the controller before, now responds to it in the xbox 360 and xbox one layouts the controller is ready 25 to 70 ms after a game starts in dualsense mode, some older games number the buttons the way windows does cross is button 2 . that is expected pick an xbox layout in the overlay for those games typing in real time the on-screen keyboard types into the game as you go , one key at a time, instead of all at once at the end backspace deletes in the game no stray q appears when the keyboard opens thanks to the tester who reported it online games connect again games and launchers that go online through windows winhttp could not connect : every request was refused before it left the console. they now connect, inside mihawkos and outside it, checked on the console against a test server steadier frames games wait for the tv, as on a pc. a game with vsync on now holds 119.8 fps at 120 hz and 59.9 fps at 60 hz without the extra frame limiter that caused the camera and input lag some players reported fable, for example games running below your tv s resolution reach the screen 3.3 times faster fewer freezes and crashes unity games no longer freeze themselves. a game that paused one of its own threads at the wrong moment could stop forever. our test program pauses and resumes a game s threads 300 times in a row: it now passes every time, inside mihawkos and outside it 10 of 10 runs on the console no more freeze when a game s crash reporter starts games inside mihawkos no longer damage mihawkos s own memory , a rare cause of crashes and odd behaviour games inside mihawkos no longer collide with the graphics driver s memory. a game, or a browser built into it could be handed memory the graphics driver also used, and crash later games keep their own thread priorities , so audio and input threads react on time, never above mihawkos itself games started from a launcher or a steam shortcut , also on another drive, keep their library setting and run inside mihawkos like the rest of your library no more black screen in games that ask for more memory than any ps5 has , such as spelunky 2 from steam mihawkos now places such a request elsewhere by itself, with no setting per game direct3d 12 games get twice the graphics upload memory inside mihawkos 2 gib instead of 1 , so games that ran out of it at start stop failing there. checked on the console: a game inside mihawkos reached 1,984 mib games that time their frames with the gpu s clock now get real readings they all read 0 before games learn which processor core each of their threads runs on ; until now every thread was told core 0 a freeze leaves a record. if a game stops drawing for about 20 seconds, mihawkos writes a snapshot of what it was doing into the log, so a freeze report shows where it stuck crash logs say where a game crashed : the file, the place in it, the address it touched and the thread, also for games that catch their own crashes. please send your log with every crash report visual c already installed every windows setup now says visual c 2010, 2012 and 2013 are installed , next to 2015 2022, which were already recorded. launchers and installers that check before starting a game stop asking a game s own visual c installer still works: it finishes quietly tested on the console: install 9.7 s, exit 0 steam on consoles with little room steam needs about 2,000 of the console s 8,192 system page tables. on firmware 10.xx to 11.xx there is often less room. if fewer than 2,800 are free, mihawkos now stops steam as it starts and shows what to do, instead of letting it fail halfway steam itself works as in 7.1 played on the console this release s build was tested on a standard ps5 firmware 13.60 , with every file on the console checked against the build the full test battery of 137 cases on a freshly restarted console, on the final build: 135 passed, and the 2 dns cases passed with one check each skipped by a test-network setting run a8final-base-2026-11-03-gate the thread-pause test, 10 runs 5 inside mihawkos, 5 outside : all passed, about 17 18 s each 7.1 updating itself to alpha 8 over an existing 7.1 setup: passed: 7.1 found alpha 8, downloaded it, checked its signature and switched; the next start installed the new windows runtime in 31 s, and the first game afterwards ran alpha 8 s windows files, in the runtime and in the existing setup, checked file by file the control overlay: its buttons, the statistics box checked against the console s own frame counter and 120 hz with the panel open controller: 13 of 13 checks in every layout known limits not fixed yet on the controller: camera drift, the create button, the touchpad as a mouse, the steam input cursor and input lag. they are planned for a later update steam s browser still runs beside mihawkos , not inside it. moving it inside lighter on the console , and letting a game take the room steam used when it starts, come in 8.1 restart the ps5 now and then. pipe memory runs out after very many program starts; mihawkos says restart the ps5 when that happens the per-boot setup is yours: your payloads after every cold boot. never use rest mode with payloads loaded not supported: drm such as denuvo, and anti-cheat such as easy anti-cheat or battleye everything else from 7.1 still applies installing or updating ps5 432776365.body: new ampr-emu-ng v0.2.0. the bundled ampr-emu-ng is now its v0.2.0 release. games carrying v0.1.0 are still recognized. the ampr tile shows the runtime and its version custom packing rules. zstd and lz4 pack take a toml profile that decides which files are packed and which stay loose: the pack tab s custom rules fold, or cli --pack-profile . the file can be on this device, a paired device or a saved nas. see docs packing.md smarter built-in packing. protected and video folders match in any case, insomniac s sound and movie containers stay loose, and the job log says why each group of files stays loose fixes much faster with many small files: inspecting gran turismo 7 95,382 files on windows went from 185-430 s to 4-5 s, and folder outputs write small files on 4 threads a folder output writes sce sys and eboot.bin last, so shadowmount never finds a half-written game a packed game whose packs also hold a file that is on disk lz4 or zstd is no longer refused: an identical copy keeps the plain file, otherwise the packed copy is used thanks luanquanzteixeira made their first contribution in 17: scanned files are opened for their attributes only on windows, behind the much faster inspection above

much faster with many small files: inspecting gran turismo 7 95,382 files on windows went from 185-430 s to 4-5 s, and folder outputs write small files on 4 threads
a folder output writes sce sys and eboot.bin last, so shadowmount never finds a half-written game
a packed game whose packs also hold a file that is on disk lz4 or zstd is no longer refused: an identical copy keeps the plain file, otherwise the packed copy is used
luanquanzteixeira made their first contribution in 17: scanned files are opened for their attributes only on windows, behind the much faster inspection above
